source.book: 《史记》卷一百零二《张释之冯唐列传》
source.excerpt: 頃之，释之為廷尉。上行，出中渭橋，有一人從橋下走出，乘輿馬驚。於是使騎捕，屬之廷尉。釋之治問。曰：「縣人來，聞蹕，匿橋下。久之，以爲行已過，即出，見乘輿車騎即走耳。」廷尉奏當，一人犯蹕，當罰金。文帝怒曰：「此人親驚吾馬，吾馬賴柔和，令他馬，固不敗傷我乎？而廷尉乃當之罰金！」釋之曰：「法者，天子所與天下公共也。今法如此而更重之，是法不信於民也。且方其時，上使立誅之則已。今既下廷尉，廷尉，天下之平也，一傾而天下用法皆爲輕重，民安所錯其手足？唯陛下察之。」良久，上曰：「廷尉當是也。」
source.transcriptionNote: 复用现有已录入批次的逐字原文快照；底本定位、原件哈希及行号保留。电子本尚不宣称纸本异文全校。

panels.title: 皇帝过桥
panels.caption: 汉文帝的车驾来到中渭桥。
panels.scene: Wide ancient stone-and-wood bridge over river: covered imperial horse carriage with modest escort approaches.

panels.title: 马受了惊
panels.caption: 有人从桥下走出，看见车骑又急忙跑开，拉车的马受了惊。
panels.scene: Commoner emerges at bridge side and recoils from approaching carriage; horse startles but all hooves and carriage remain safely grounded, nobody injured.

evidence.excerpt: 有一人從橋下走出，乘輿馬驚

panels.title: 交给廷尉
panels.caption: 骑士把人抓住，交给张释之审问。
panels.scene: Guard escorts uninjured commoner into simple Han judicial hall, where teal-robed Zhang Shizhi sits listening. No beating or heavy chains.

panels.title: 原来是误会
panels.caption: 那人说，自己先躲在桥下，等了许久，以为车驾已经过去，才走出来。
panels.scene: Close scene of worried commoner explaining with open hands while Zhang Shizhi listens attentively.

panels.title: 依法罚金
panels.caption: 张释之审理后奏报：这个人违反出行禁令，按法应当罚金。
panels.scene: Zhang Shizhi presents closed plain bamboo slips to the emperor in burgundy; commoner kept in distant background. No readable text.

panels.title: 皇帝不满意
panels.caption: 文帝生气了：“他差点让我受伤，怎么只判罚金？”
panels.scene: Emperor looks angry but remains seated, gesturing toward Zhang Shizhi; official stands composed.

panels.title: 不能因怒加刑
panels.caption: 张释之说：“法令原本如此，若因为这次惊马就加重处罚，百姓还怎么相信它？”
panels.scene: Steady close view of Zhang Shizhi respectfully arguing, one hand open, emperor listening. No violence.

evidence.excerpt: 今法如此而更重之，是法不信於民也

panels.title: 判得对
panels.caption: 文帝沉默了许久，终于说：“廷尉判得对。”
panels.scene: Final balanced two-person scene: emperor expression softens and gives a small accepting nod toward calm Zhang Shizhi.

adaptations: 不把文帝的愤怒补写成已下达处死命令。
未有伤亡，马惊以动作示意，不画翻车或受伤；罚金不补具体数额。

checks: 逐格核对情节、人物与关键道具
直接参考用户选定的徙木立信：夸张造型、简练黑线、平涂色块
无嵌入正文，无虚构结果
imageReview.notes: 无翻车伤亡或处死场景，人物服饰与面容连续，结尾为文帝接受判决。 已完成本轮画风统一并复查。

Composition: STRICT equal rectangular grid of TWO columns and 4 rows. Read left to right, top to bottom. All row heights equal, all column widths equal. Canvas target 1024 x 1280. Narrow straight cream gutters, maximum 4 pixels; no outer margin, no header/footer; every scene fills its own complete LANDSCAPE cell. No merged panels, insets, or changes in layout.
Style: classic 1950s-1960s Chinese small-picture storybook, early Shanghai Animation folk-art sensibility. Graceful expressive fine ink outlines, hand-painted gouache, mineral blue/green, muted cinnabar and ochre, textured warm cream paper, restrained humor and human facial expressions. Rich but legible environments; varied wide/medium/close shots. NOT modern anime, 3D, glossy or photorealistic. Ancient China, no modern objects. No words, letters, numbers, captions, speech balloons, calligraphy, watermark or symbols that look like writing ANYWHERE. Clothing and face continuity within the atlas is essential.
Characters and invariants: Han emperor Wen: mature man, burgundy robe, modest black Han formal cap, short beard; rides in a modest covered horse-drawn carriage. Zhang Shizhi: mature narrow-bearded official, teal robe, black Han cap, carries plain blank bamboo slips. Commoner: tan robe, cloth headwrap. Same figures throughout. No violence, no execution, no modern court wigs, no readable writing.
Scenes in this exact order:
1. Wide ancient stone-and-wood bridge over river: covered imperial horse carriage with modest escort approaches.
2. Commoner emerges at bridge side and recoils from approaching carriage; horse startles but all hooves and carriage remain safely grounded, nobody injured.

6. Emperor looks angry but remains seated, gesturing toward Zhang Shizhi; official stands composed.
7. Steady close view of Zhang Shizhi respectfully arguing, one hand open, emperor listening. No violence.
8. Final balanced two-person scene: emperor expression softens and gives a small accepting nod toward calm Zhang Shizhi.

Do not import reference story events, characters, sword/pole/fish props, captions or text. Draw the target in the same artistic language as images 2 and 3: strongly designed Chinese folk/early Shanghai animation characters, larger expressive heads, compact stylized adult bodies, angular expressive eyebrows and noses made with very few confident strokes, small curved eyes, humorous expressive poses, fluid varied BLACK ink contours, FLAT matte pigment blocks with only spare broad ink-wash texture. Reduce realistic anatomy, skin modeling, facial shading, brocade patterns, tiny clothing folds and detailed background rendering dramatically. Robes are mostly solid muted color fields with spare trim, NO all-over elaborate embroidery. Simplify background buildings into rhythmic geometric silhouettes, light ink washes and warm UNPAINTED cream space. Restrained indigo, ochre and cinnabar, subtle paper grain like image 2, no dense brown texture overlay. NOT realistic illustrated portraiture, glossy painting, modern anime, chibi toys, 3D or photorealism. Keep all characters ADULT unless explicitly elderly. Preserve each character's consistent identifying robe color, beard and role, but redraw their form in this stylized way. No words, numerals, letters, title, captions, calligraphy, speech bubbles, watermark or readable marks ANYWHERE, including on documents, garments or props. Ignore all text visible in the style reference. Do not add a header or footer.

previousAfterword.title: 把怒气留在判决之外
paragraphs: “廷尉”是当时审理刑狱的官职。故事中的分歧不在于百姓是否惊马，而在于能不能因为皇帝生气，临时加重法定处罚。
《史记》记载文帝最后接受了张释之的判决。故事保留当时的制度语境，不将其等同于现代司法制度。

takeaway.title: 先有规矩，再作判断
takeaway.text: 遇到让自己生气的事，也要给已有的规则留出位置。

afterword.title: 把怒气留在判决之外
paragraphs: “廷尉”是当时审理刑狱的官职。故事中的分歧不在于百姓是否惊马，而在于能不能因为皇帝生气，临时加重法定处罚。
文帝最终接受了张释之的判决。张释之守住的，是法令不能随一时喜怒改变的尺度。
